visible: workspace beliefs and reported evidence metadata

primary_reason: UDU-net is the strongest simple post-hoc explanation from A/B, and differs from CRV-net mainly by counting every structural descendant rather than only beliefs whose current resolved state can change under opposite tool reports.
cost_semantics: Verification cost is denominated in the same normalized decision-loss utility units used by weighted_net_gain. weighted_net_gain = weighted_epistemic_gain - total_verification_cost.
candidate_formula: CRV-net(action) = uncertainty(P) * counterfactual_affected_reported_utility_fraction(P, tool) * max(0, 2*reported_tool_accuracy-1) - tool_cost. Choose the maximum positive action; if none is positive, choose NO VERIFICATION.
matched_simple_formula: UDU-net(action) = uncertainty(P) * structural_reported_utility_fraction(P) * max(0, 2*reported_tool_accuracy-1) - tool_cost. Choose the maximum positive action; if none is positive, choose NO VERIFICATION.

decision.PASS: primary mean difference >= 0.005 AND primary 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND CRV-minus-UDU weighted epistemic gain >= 0 AND CRV-minus-UDU unweighted epistemic gain >= -0.005 AND CRV net harm rate <= 0.10 AND <= UDU net harm rate + 0.02
decision.AMBER: CRV mean weighted net gain > UDU but one or more PASS thresholds miss
decision.FAIL_KILL_CRV_V1: CRV mean weighted net gain <= UDU mean weighted net gain
decision.NO_OP_SUBCLAIM_WITHHELD: If CRV early-stop/no-verification realization rate is < 0.05, do not claim the no-op mechanism was meaningfully exercised even if the primary test passes

secondary_interpretation.legacy_debt: Reference only because the frozen old debt policy had no acquisition-cost/no-op semantics; it is not the primary fairness comparator.
secondary_interpretation.structural_net: Tests whether uncertainty is needed once structural utility and tool economics are available.
secondary_interpretation.uncertainty_own_net: Tests whether downstream structure adds value beyond local uncertainty and local decision importance.

license_if_passed: Prospective support only on a synthetic adversarial generator designed in the same research program. A pass would support counterfactual revision consequence as a useful scheduling signal under noisy reported metadata and fallible verification. It would not establish real-world source reliability, inferred lineage, natural-language extraction, real-tool benefit, LLM capability gain, or novelty beyond related Value-of-Information/active-diagnosis ideas.
do_not: change Generator C after inspecting controller outcomes
change CRV-net or UDU-net formulas after inspecting outcomes
change seed range, n_worlds, budget, cost semantics or PASS thresholds after inspecting outcomes
use hidden simulation fields in any controller
tune verifier costs or accuracies after seeing which policy wins
call a PASS evidence that persistent storage itself is the mechanism
call a PASS a real-world, LLM, web-search, source-lineage-inference or calibrated-source-trust result
rescue CRV v1 with post-hoc weights if UDU wins; record the failure and redesign prospectively
